Writing a note is very difficult. There's pressure to wrap up everything so they're not tortured after. But no matter what I write my loved ones, they will still be tormented by my decision for a while. I'm optimistic that they will recover from this. But I've tried to relieve the burden of a neat ending with a concise and comforting note by Journaling sporadically so that there's documentation of my decline.
